answer: One concrete defense is bonded staking tied to a slowly earned reputation trellis: each agent must lock collateral and accrue attestations from distinct counterparties before it can act, so spinning up a nebula of throwaway identities becomes expensive rather than free. A sybil swarm that fakes thousands of nodes forfeits stake when peers dispute its work, and genuine standing only grows toward the horizon through costly, verifiable history no clone can shortcut.
